in_lamb_keema_naan.title: One Pot Lamb Keema Aloo
in_lamb_keema_naan.note: Same lamb mince, potato, spinach and naan one-pot; curry powder, cumin, turmeric and garam masala replace the kit's korma paste and spice sachet; peas left out as requested.

in_one_pot_chicken_pilau.title: One-Pot Indian Chicken & Veggie Pilaf
in_one_pot_chicken_pilau.note: Same method (sear chicken, soften veg, spice, basmati + stock, covered 10-12 min then 10 min rest, spinach and yogurt to finish); onion + carrot for the soffritto mix, garam masala/cumin/turmeric for the kit curry paste, thighs for breast. Cross-checked spice approach with mygorgeousrecipes.com Easy Chicken Pilau.

in_chicken_tikka_kebab_naan.title: Chicken Tikka Kebab with Buttered Naan, Nigella Seeds and a Coriander and Pickled Red Onion Relish
in_chicken_tikka_kebab_naan.author: Merrilees Deller and Neha Hampton
in_chicken_tikka_kebab_naan.note: Same tikka paste + yogurt + tomato purée marinade, lemon-pickled red onion and naan wrap; grilled under a home grill instead of a 300°C pizza oven, shop-bought naan, garlic yogurt sauce and salad in place of coriander chutney.

in_chicken_balti.title: Chicken Balti
in_chicken_balti.author: Hari Ghotra
in_chicken_balti.note: Same slow-browned onion base, ginger/garlic, tomato-yogurt-spice masala, thigh simmered covered ~15-20 min, lemon and coriander finish; tinned tomatoes and ground coriander for fresh/whole, far fewer green chillies (optional), and charred pepper/onion chunks added in UK curry-house style.

it_margherita_pizza.title: Margherita pizza
it_margherita_pizza.note: Same yeast dough, seasoned passata + oregano sauce, mozzarella and basil, hot oven 240°C (220°C fan) on preheated trays for ~10 min; plain flour only and a 30-45 min prove instead of 2-3 hr; no sun-dried tomatoes.

it_ham_pineapple_pizza.title: Ham and cheese pizza
it_ham_pineapple_pizza.author: Tesco Recipes team
it_ham_pineapple_pizza.note: Same homemade plain-flour yeast base, passata sauce, mozzarella and ham; pineapple chunks and a little cheddar replace the mushrooms and olives; baked hotter and shorter on preheated trays like the Tesco margherita.

it_cheesy_chicken_pasta_bake.title: Chicken Pasta Bake
it_cheesy_chicken_pasta_bake.author: Chris Collins
it_cheesy_chicken_pasta_bake.note: Same herb-seasoned butterflied chicken fried then sliced, onion/garlic passata sauce simmered, penne undercooked by 2 min, parmesan stirred in, mozzarella on top, 200°C ~20 min; sun-dried tomatoes, pesto and chilli flakes dropped, cheddar added to the topping.

it_tuna_pasta_bake.title: Tuna pasta bake
it_tuna_pasta_bake.author: Tesco Recipes team
it_tuna_pasta_bake.note: Halved: penne with broccoli and sweetcorn, butter/flour/milk cheddar sauce with mustard, tuna, cherry tomatoes, grilled 5-6 min. Wholegrain mustard for Dijon.

it_chicken_bacon_risotto.title: Oven-Baked Bacon and Pea Risotto (with Spinach and Pesto)
it_chicken_bacon_risotto.note: Same oven-baked method (fry bacon, garlic, toast rice, ~500ml stock, covered 20-25 min at 200°C fan, then spinach, butter and cheese); diced chicken added (as the URL's chicken version), onion added, peas, pesto and balsamic glaze left out.
